summary_text: Major Partnerships: Corning Deal — Nvidia announced a partnership with Corning to build three dedicated U.S. manufacturing plants, with Nvidia investing up to $2.7 billion in the glassmaker including warrants for 15 million shares. The 'co-packaged optics' shift aims to increase data speeds while slashing power consumption by up to 20 times. IREN Partnership — Nvidia announced a partnership with IREN Limited, striking a strategic agreement to accelerate next-generation AI data center deployment, with reports indicating Nvidia investing up to $2.1 billion. Stock Performance: Over the past week, NVDA fell 4.3% while AMD posted another 3% gain and Micron surged 7.3%, making NVDA the laggard within its own sector. However, Nvidia shares climbed in pre-market trading on Wednesday as investors reacted to positive developments across the AI and semiconductor industry. Upcoming Earnings: Nvidia will host a conference call on Wednesday, May 20, at 2 p.m. PT (5 p.m. ET) to discuss its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year.
